notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market SaaS (product teams for B2B knowledge search). Evaluating Hosted API first (quick demo + small POC) then moving to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Interest heavily around reranking endpoint capabilities.

Key requirements / context:
- Primary workload: re-ranking search results surfaced in product and support flows. Offline scoring for nightly reranks + online rerank endpoint for real-time user queries.
- SLAs/targets: p95 latency target ~120ms for online rerank in EU/NA, throughput 150 reqs/s steady for peek windows.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade higher cost for lower latency but want quantifiable unit economics.
- Model preferences: open-model variants preferred; will accept Redwood-verified model family with fallback smaller variant. Doing A/B vs current BM25+embedding reranker.
- Data residency: EU+NA, but initial POC uses US test data. Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logging needed, KMS for key lifecycle.
